notes.title: Switching gears from RPG Maker MZ to Unity
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

After careful consideration and weighing all the options, I have decided to switch gears from RPG Maker MZ to Unity for the creation of this game. While this decision wasn't made lightly, I believe it's the best course of action to ensure the highest quality gaming experience for all of you.

Why the switch, you may ask? Well, as I delved deeper into development, I encountered some limitations within RPG Maker MZ, particularly in the farming system. I refuse to compromise on the gameplay and overall quality of Whispers of Sylvan Grove, and Unity offers me the flexibility and freedom needed to bring my vision to life without constraints.

Now, you're probably wondering if this means a delay in the release. The honest answer is, probably not. With approximately a decade of Unity experience under my belt, I am confident in my ability to tackle this challenge efficiently. While I can't predict the future with certainty, I am committed to transparency throughout this process. Once I complete the first map already in progress and gauge the time it takes, I will have a better understanding of the timeline moving forward.

I am immensely grateful for your support and understanding as I embark on this new phase of development. Rest assured, Whispers of Sylvan Grove is shaping up to be an enchanting adventure, and I can't wait to share it with you all.

Stay tuned for further updates and sneak peeks along the way!

Warmest regards,
Jayy
